init_GANTrainer: create a GANTrainer instance with a dataset path, GPU flag, visualization module, and training config
trainOnEpoch_GANTrainer: train the GAN model on one epoch using a DataLoader, tracking losses and saving checkpoints
loadSavedTraining_GANTrainer: load a saved checkpoint to resume GAN training from a specific scale and iteration
saveCheckpoint_GANTrainer: save the GAN model weights, temporary config, loss logs, and reference vectors to disk
getDBLoader_GANTrainer: get a DataLoader for the training dataset at a given resolution scale with proper transforms
